name: Memory: Rewind
source:
Embark on a thrilling detective visual novel adventure, accompanied by your quirky assistant, Olivina. Navigate through a bizarre case with unique investigation gameplay, and meet a diverse cast of characters as you unravel the story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与古灵精怪的助手Olivina一起，踏上惊险刺激的侦探视觉小说冒险。借助独特的调查玩法，追查离奇案件，结识形形色色的角色，逐步揭开故事的真相。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611140/]Steam[/url]]
